rationale: The schema change requires `entity_id` to be handled as UTF-8 encoded bytes in v2. The literal string assignments and dictionary key assignments for `entity_id` must use explicit encoding/decoding to maintain compatibility with the new protobuf definition. Lines 15 and 21 decode the entity_id from bytes to a string for output consistency, while line 68 encodes the string into UTF-8 bytes for construction. Line 67 remains unchanged as it is v1-specific and unaffected by this change.
assumptions: UTF-8 encoding/decoding will handle all valid text identifiers correctly, including empty strings and Unicode characters.
The protobuf parser handles the bytes-to-string conversion implicitly for v2 entities during deserialization.
